config.selection: Use whole cones contained within one partition cell and the latitude domain. Hold out one cone per populated fitting stratum to choose nside and pooling. Test cells do not enter spatial fitting or selection; shared global shapes and priors remain fixed.
config.model: Shared component shapes, sky-dependent proportions and separately pooled non-quasar surface density. Local mode refits the same proportions and counts in an explicitly supplied cone.

south.conditional_cv_scope: Global shapes and original prior fixed; inner cones withheld only from adaptation.

north.conditional_cv_scope: Global shapes and original prior fixed; inner cones withheld only from adaptation.

geometry.source_cell_check: All retained source positions verified inside their cone centre's partition cell.
geometry.scope: Partitions isolate new spatial fits. Global component shapes and priors retain their original training provenance.
